items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Then we got Kenneth Stuart on trombone in Billy Franklin's place.

ctx.x: And we still had Billy Franklin on trombone until he got hurt. That was in 1936 when he got hurt. Then we got Kenneth Stuart on trombone in Billy Franklin's place.
Now, in the summer of '37, according to the recordings, you know, the recording personnel, there was only you and George Dixon and Louis Taylor from the previous band.
